items.image: images/Chicago Skyline A Fluid Transcription,7x 79 in,Ink and watercolor on rice paper,2025.jpg
items.title: Chicago Skyline: A Fluid Transcription / 《芝加哥：流墨长卷》
items.meta: Year: 2025  Medium: Ink and watercolor on rice paper (Scroll)  Size: 7 x 79 in
items.description:
I approach the Chicago skyline not as a fortress of steel, but as a rhythmic, atmospheric vibration. Painted on rice paper, the work abandons architectural rigidity for intuitive, fluid gestures. I utilize the paper's absorbency to let water-heavy blue pigments bleed, softening hard geometry into abstract verticality. Repetitive grids and washing tones do not merely depict facades; they capture the cold, melancholic breath of the city viewed from a distance. The scroll format introduces a temporal dimension, unfolding the view not as a static snapshot, but as a continuous, drifting narrative. By relinquishing tight control, I allow the medium to dictate form, transforming the external landscape into an internal psychological space---a fleeting memory of the city rather than a document.

我不把芝加哥的天际线看作钢铁的堡垒，而看作一种有韵律的、大气的震颤。这件作品画在宣纸上，抛开了建筑的坚硬，用直觉的、流动的手势取而代之。我利用宣纸的吸水性，让水分饱满的蓝色颜料自然洇开，把生硬的几何软化成抽象的竖向线条。重复的网格与洗染的色调不只是描绘建筑立面，更捕捉了从远处看这座城市时那冷冽而忧郁的气息。卷轴的形制引入了时间的维度——展开的不是一张静止的快照，而是一段连绵的、漂流的叙事。放下紧绷的控制，我让媒介自己决定形态，把外部的风景转化为内在的心理空间——那是关于这座城市一闪而过的记忆，而不是一份文献。

items.image: images/The Subconscious River,128x11 in,Ink&mixed media on paper,2025.jpg
items.title: The Subconscious River / 潜意识之河
items.meta: Year: 2025  Medium: Ink and mixed media on paper (Scroll) / 纸本水墨与综合材料 (长卷)  Size: 128x11 in
items.description:
Black ink crashes into gold. Chaos spreads across the long paper. I lost control on purpose. Growing up with traditional Chinese scrolls, I was taught to see nature as a balanced narrative. But my internal world is not balanced at all. So I poured fluid ink to map my own psychological anxiety. The scroll format forces you to read the panic over time. It is a timeline of a mind losing its grip on the physical world.

黑色的墨水撞击着金色。混乱在长长的纸上蔓延。我是故意失控的。伴随着中国传统画卷长大，我被教导要将自然看作一种平衡的叙事。但我的内心世界根本就不平衡。所以我倾倒流动的水墨，来绘制我自己的心理焦虑。长卷的格式迫使你随着时间的推移去阅读这种恐慌。它是一个理智正在对物理世界失去掌控的时间线。

items.title: TIME / 时间
items.meta: 2026,28x50in,Oil on canvas
items.description:
Time follows an inward rhythm beyond rigid measure. In the intervals between order and pause, thoughts and memories wander freely through quiet depths. A sensitive, abundant inner life persists there, preserving something intimate and true that resists assimilation.

时间在刻度之外，循着内心的节奏静默流淌。在秩序与停顿的间隙里，敏锐、丰沛而自由的内在生命悄然蛰伏，任思绪与记忆向深处游走、漫溢。幽微之中，始终留存着最本真、最不被同化的生命底色。

items.title: Cold Mountain / 冷山
items.meta: 2026,14x14in,,Oil on canvas
items.description:
In solitude, the world’s clamor falls away, and even familiar surroundings feel remote. An inward coldness changes how the world feels. In the mountain’s stillness, private feeling and external reality become inseparable; the place one inhabits becomes a state of mind.

独处时，万象的喧嚣渐渐退去，熟悉的世界也显得遥远。冷意从内心蔓延，悄然改变着世界的触感。在山的静默中，个人的感受与外部现实逐渐难以分开，所处之地也成为心中之境。

items.title: Street I / II / 街道 I / II
items.meta: 2026,8x10in,Oil on canvas
items.description:
Familiar routes shift quietly in memory, becoming a silent, estranged inner theater. The certainty of daily life recedes, while wandering thoughts and lingering hesitations echo within. These streets give shelter to a lucid solitude that has nowhere else to settle.

熟悉的日常路径在记忆中悄然错位，化作静默而疏离的内心剧场。原有的确定感渐渐退去，游离的思绪与未尽的迟疑在其中回响。这里收留着那份无处安放的清醒与孤独。

items.title: Gossamer / 《游丝》
items.meta: 2026,20x16in,Acrylicon fabric
items.description:
Delicate, vulnerable feeling reaches like gossamer into emptiness, seeking something to hold on to and something that answers. A tentative touch meets a longing that will not let go. Amid darkness and weightlessness, a warm breath of life persists at the edge of dissolution.

纤细而脆弱的感知，如游丝般向空茫探出，寻觅依附与回响。轻盈的试探与执拗的眷恋，在幽暗与失重中交汇。濒于消散之际，生命仍牵系着一缕真实而温热的呼吸。

items.title: Psychological Spill / The Fractured Internal Landscape / 心理溢出 / 碎裂的内在风景
items.meta: Year: 2025  Medium: Oil on canvas  Size: 12 x 12 in
items.description:
A bright yellow sphere burns in the corner. Reality fractures right there. I paint the exact second the external world melts into a dark psychological void. Cold, concrete geometry collapses completely. A dark shape covered in blue patterns spills across the jagged architecture. I am forcing the internal anxiety of isolation out into the physical room. The walls just cannot hold the mind anymore.

一个明亮的黄色球体在角落里燃烧。现实就在那里碎裂。我画下了外部世界融化进黑暗心理虚空的那个精确秒数。冰冷、具体的几何形态彻底坍塌。一个布满蓝色图案的黑暗形状在锯齿状的建筑上溢流开来。我正把孤立带来的内在焦虑强行推入这个物理房间。墙壁再也无法禁锢思想了。

items.title: The Dance of Wither and Bloom / 《起舞的枯荣》
items.meta: 2026,10x8in,Acrylic and airbrush on fabric
items.description:
Vulnerability struggles in the bitter cold, while vitality dances through pain in the wind. Visceral suffering and unceasing longing intertwine deep within the soul. Withering and blooming remain inseparable within a single dance of life, carrying both this tension and a profound attachment to being alive.

脆弱在严寒中挣扎，生机带着痛楚在风中起舞。切肤之痛与不息的渴望，在灵魂深处交织。枯与荣彼此牵引，成为同一场生命之舞，承载着挣扎，也承载着对存在的眷恋。

items.title: The Subtle Quiver / 《幽微的轻颤》
items.meta: 2026,8x10in,Acrylic and airbrush on fabric
items.description:
Deep within, the slightest touch can set off a subtle, unmistakable tremor. Feelings that have not yet found words settle quietly and endure, preserving the most intimate stirrings of life.

内心深处，一次微小的触碰，也能引发幽微而真实的战栗。那些尚未来得及被言说的感受，在静谧中沉降、留存，成为生命最纯粹、最隐秘的回响。

items.title: 映像 | Reflection
items.meta: Year: 2024  Medium: Oil on canvas  Size: 18 x 24 in
items.description:
熟悉的面孔也可能突然显得陌生，连自己的形象也不例外。我在这幅画中追问，自我如何在观看中被辨认，又如何变得难以确定。强烈的红色与厚重的笔触，加深了凝视带来的压迫感。亲近与疏离同时存在，观看自己的过程也因此成为一次迟疑的确认。

A familiar face can suddenly seem strange, even when it is our own. In this painting, I consider how a sense of self emerges through looking and becomes uncertain in the same encounter. The intensity of red and the weight of the brushwork heighten the pressure of the gaze. Familiarity and distance coexist, making the act of looking at oneself a tentative search for recognition.

items.title: 漫流 | Sensory Wash
items.meta: Year: 2025  Medium: Oil on canvas  Size: 20 x 28 in
items.description:
声音、水流与情绪仿佛漫过身体，使内外之间的界限逐渐松动。我将具象的人物与流动的线条相叠，呈现一种放下防备、沉浸其中的状态。身体依然保有自身的形态，却向周围的世界敞开。感知就在这种相互渗透中发生，人与环境也由此建立联系。

Sound, water, and emotion seem to wash over the body, loosening the boundary between inner and outer worlds. I bring the figure into contact with flowing lines to evoke a state of immersion in which defenses soften. The body retains its form while opening to its surroundings. Perception takes shape through this exchange, connecting an individual to the world beyond the skin.

items.title: Luminous Filter / The White Veil / 发光的滤镜 / 白色面纱
items.meta: Year: 2024 Medium: Oil on canvas Size: 36 x 24 in
items.description:
A white veil catches the light. She breathes quietly. I painted this to figure out how we actually carry our cultural identity across oceans. Moving from Beijing to Chicago made me see my heritage not as a heavy trap, but as a glowing, protective layer. I use soft white and deep blue oils to paint her traditional dress. The fabric is semi-transparent. It filters the harsh outside world. She is looking inward. Protecting a very quiet, personal space of history.

一层白色的面纱捕捉住了光线。她静静地呼吸着。我画这幅画是为了弄清楚我们到底是如何跨越海洋承载我们的文化身份的。从北京搬到芝加哥，让我不再把我的文化遗产看作一个沉重的陷阱，而是一层发光的、保护性的外壳。我用柔和的白色和深蓝色的油画颜料来画她的传统服饰。这布料是半透明的。它过滤掉了外面刺耳的世界。她正向内注视。保护着一个非常安静的、个人的历史空间。

items.title: Spheres of the Feline Spirit: A Pluralistic Vision / 《猫灵之球：多元视野》
items.meta: Year: 2024  Medium: Oil on canvas  Size:18 x 24 in
items.description:
I approach the feline form not as a singular organism, but as a vibrating accumulation of cosmic spheres. Painted with heavy oil pigments, the work abandons traditional biological realism for a pluralistic, geometric language. I utilize the medium's inherent impasto to sculpt each individual circle, transforming the flat canvas into a tactile field of depth and light. The sharp, complementary contrast between the atmospheric teals and the earth-bound oranges does not merely delineate space; it captures the internal tension between the unknown and the grounded.

The emerald-green eyes act as a gravitational anchor, holding the drifting fragments of form in a state of permanent, watchful equilibrium. By fragmenting the face into these discrete, textured cells, I allow the medium to dictate a new kind of order, transforming a domestic subject into a psychological landscape—a study of how identity is forged from a multitude of independent energies rather than a static document of a creature.

我不把猫的形态视为单一的有机体，而视为宇宙球体振动着的聚合体。我用厚重的油彩作画，抛开传统的生物写实，转向一种多元的几何语言。我利用颜料天然的厚涂肌理塑造每一个圆，把平面的画布变成一片可触的、充满深度与光的场域。雾气般的青绿色与沉着的橙色之间强烈的互补对比，不只是划分空间，更捕捉了未知与尘世之间的内在张力。

祖母绿的眼睛如同引力之锚，将漂流的形态碎片固定在一种永恒而警觉的平衡之中。我把面部分解为这些独立的、有肌理的细胞，让媒介自己去建立一种新的秩序——把一个家养的题材变成心理风景，去研究身份如何由众多独立的能量锻造而成，而不只是对一只生灵的静态记录。

items.title: The Golden Boundary
items.meta: **Year:** 2025  **Medium:** Oil on canvas  **Size:** 18 x 22 in
items.description:
She turns her back to the viewer. Flat, golden patterns start to swallow her space. I took Gustav Klimt's decorative language and forced it into a modern clash. The realistic, breathing flesh fights against the rigid 2D geometry. We constantly build beautiful surfaces to hide our messy realities. I want to see which visual system wins. Will the pattern completely erase her human identity?

她转过身背对观众。扁平的金色图案开始吞噬她的空间。我借用了古斯塔夫·克里姆特的装饰语言，并将其逼入一场现代的冲突中。写实的、呼吸着的血肉与死板的二维几何图形在对抗。我们不断地构建美丽的表面来隐藏我们混乱的现实。我想看看哪种视觉系统会赢。这些图案会彻底抹杀她的人类身份吗？

items.title: Sunlit Ripples / 阳光下的涟漪
items.meta: **Year:** 2024  **Medium:** Oil on canvas  **Size:** 16 x 20 in
items.description:
Bright yellow explodes against the deep blue water. Just pure light. I wanted to take a classic Chinese motif and inject it with the heavy, saturated energy of Western oil painting. The water ripples outward. Little red fish dart through the shadows. I am not painting a quiet, passive garden anymore. I am painting intense vitality. So I use thick, bright yellow strokes to make the leaves feel alive and muscular. They push right out of the dark water into the sun.

明亮的黄色在深蓝色的水面上炸开。只有纯粹的光。我想采用一个经典的中国主题，并为其注入西方油画那种厚重、饱和的能量。水面荡起涟漪。红色的小鱼在阴影中穿梭。我画的不再是一个安静、被动的花园。我画的是强烈的生命力。所以我用厚重、明亮的黄色笔触让叶子感觉充满生机和力量感。它们直接从暗水中破水而出，冲向阳光。

items.title: Internal Bloom
items.meta: Year: 2024  Medium: Oil on canvas  Size: 36 x 24 in
items.description:
A red heart burns inside a cage of blue bones. I cut the body open. Not with a knife, but with paint. I want to show the exact place where biological life meets emotional pain. The girl floats in a fluid, dreamlike space. So I exposed her ribs to break the defensive shell of the human form. I am digging into the vulnerability hidden under our meat. We hide our most vital organs behind bone. I forced them out into the open air.

一颗红色的心脏在蓝色骨骼的笼子里燃烧。我切开了这具身体。不是用刀，而是用颜料。我想展示生物生命与情感痛苦相遇的确切位置。女孩漂浮在一个流动的、梦幻般的空间里。所以我暴露了她的肋骨，以此打破人类形态的防御外壳。我正在挖掘隐藏在我们皮肉之下的脆弱性。我们将最重要的器官藏在骨头后面。我把它们强行拽到了露天之下。

items.title: Through the Lens / 《透过镜头》
items.meta: Year: 2022 Medium:wooden board, acrylic, water color, rice paper Size 18*22in
items.description:
Misinformation on the internet negatively and unconsciously impacts our thinking. The things we see through the internet are filtered and polished, but people often choose to believe before thinking. Through this piece, I wish to advocate for others to see the world with their own eyes.

该作品是一幅板画，主体由木板和宣纸制成，绘制方面则是用了丙烯颜料和水彩。用颜料在木板中间绘制了一个镜头，意为通过镜头来认识事物，作品灵感来源于对当下网络快节奏接触世界方式的思考。而这样接触到的事物是经过修饰的，绝大多数与事物本身有着差别。人们却更容易相信它的真实性，忘记了去思考。我希望通过平面画与实体色彩的结合，引导读者不仅通过镜头画面来认识事物，更要去接触真实的事物本身。

items.title: Knot / 《绳结》
items.meta: Year: 2022 Medium ink, watercolor, rice paper Size 20in*24in
items.description:
Practicing Chinese calligraphy was a big part of my childhood; influenced by my roots, I combined elements from Chinese ink painting and elements from western art to create a contrast.

水墨抽象，我用的是中国的水墨元素。我用的是水彩颜料，但用的是国画里的颜色，我想把它们整合在一起，形成一种阴阳，中西方的对比与结合。我还用书法的笔触来表达一种润滑和粗糙的对比。

items.title: Turn a Blind Eye / 《睁一只眼闭一只眼》
items.meta: Year: 2022 Medium magazine collage Size 14*17in
items.description:
One eye is open to see the positive things in life and one eye is closed to hide from the negative. We often care about wealth and prosperity and are indifferent toward the dark side of society, avoiding them at all costs.

这幅作品主体是由剪裁的图片拼贴而成。作品围绕着一只睁着的眼睛，一只闭着的眼睛展开。加入了被观事物的元素。它蕴含着中国俗语"睁一只眼闭一只眼"的意思。即对本该被阻止的事情装作看不见，纵容其发生。作品将美好的事物放在了睁开的眼睛下面，意为大家都更愿意享受荣华富贵；而那些社会的黑暗则在闭着的眼睛下面，表示人们对社会黑暗的漠不关心。

items.title: Thermal Portraits / The Psychological Thermometer / 热像肖像 / 心理温度计(Triptych / View All Panels)
items.meta: Year: 2025  Medium: Oil on canvas (Triptych) / 布面油画 (三联画)  Size: 11x14 in,8x10 in,9x12in
items.description:
Blue. Red. Green. I paint faces like weather reports. The flesh is a lie. It is just a surface to map internal temperature. I shoved these three canvases together into one group. Why? Because identity never stays at a stable room temperature. Studying in Chicago far from Beijing, my psychological state violently swings from frozen isolation to burning anxiety in a single afternoon. I attacked the canvas with thick oil strokes. I refuse to blend the edges smoothly. I want the raw color to punch your eyes. Do we actually look like the physical bodies in the mirror, or are we just shifting masses of emotional heat?

蓝色。红色。绿色。我像画天气预报一样画脸。血肉是一个谎言。它只是一个用来映射内部温度的表面。我把这三块画布硬塞成一组。为什么？因为身份从来不会停留在稳定的室温下。远离北京在芝加哥求学，我的心理状态在一个下午之内就会从冰冻的孤立感暴力地摇摆到燃烧的焦虑中。我用厚重的油画笔触攻击画布。我拒绝平滑地融合边缘。我要让原始的色彩刺痛你的眼睛。我们真的长得像镜子里的物理躯体吗，还是我们只是一团团不断游移的情绪热量？

items.title: Domestic Uncanny / 《暗影疏离》
items.meta: Year: 2024  Medium: Oil on canvas (Triptych)  Size: 8 x 12 in (each panel)
items.description:
In this triptych, I explore how internal isolation projects onto the neutral screen of everyday architecture. I treat these solitary spaces---a sterile restroom, a dim stairwell, a concrete facade---as receptive surfaces for the subconscious. The unsettling details are not objective realities, but materializations of inner fear: a hand clinging to the window sill from the outside, or a fleeting face in the mirror. I painted these scenes with a clinical flatness to heighten the contrast with these surreal intrusions. I attempt to visualize the dissonance of solitude, where the silence of a familiar domestic setting is interrupted by projections of fragility. The work suggests that the "uncanny" is not an external intruder, but a reflection of our own psyche. I seek to capture that vibration of anxiety where the safety of the home dissolves, and the walls themselves manifest our deepest terrors.

在这组三联画中，我探索了内在的孤立感如何投射到日常建筑这块中立的屏幕上。我将这些孤独的空间——无菌的洗手间、昏暗的楼梯间、混凝土外立面——视为潜意识的承载面。我所描绘的那些令人不安的细节并非客观现实，而是内心恐惧的物质化：一只手从窗外紧扣窗台，或是镜中转瞬即逝的脸。我以一种克制的、近乎临床的平涂手法描绘这些场景，以加强与这些超现实入侵物的对比。我试图将孤独的失调感可视化——当熟悉的家庭环境的寂静被自身脆弱性的投射所打断时。作品暗示"诡异"并非来自外部的入侵者，而是我们自身心灵的映射。我寻求捕捉焦虑的那种特定震颤：当家的安全感消解，墙壁本身似乎开始显现我们最深层、无法言说的恐惧。

items.title: Walking Shells / Grant Park / 行走的躯壳 / 格兰特公园
items.meta: Year: 2025  Medium: Oil on canvas  Size: 10 x 30 in
items.description:
Giant legs march across the bright green grass. But nobody has a head. I saw these massive sculptures in Chicago's Grant Park and felt an instant chill. They just keep walking forward. A blind, collective movement. Growing up in a huge city like Beijing, crowds usually felt like they had a shared, unified purpose. But here in the US, these heavy figures feel totally isolated even when they stand shoulder to shoulder. So I painted them but stripped away their original rust. I forced different weird textures onto their bodies. One is literally melting. Another is trapped in a rigid checkerboard pattern. I want to test how identity works when you completely remove the face. Do we just become the graphic patterns we wear? We walk. We occupy space. We just never really look at each other.

巨大的腿在翠绿的草坪上行军。但没有人有头。我在芝加哥的格兰特公园看到了这些巨大的雕塑，瞬间感到一阵寒意。它们只是一直向前走。一种盲目的、集体的移动。在像北京这样的大城市长大，人群通常让人感觉他们有一个共享的、统一的目标。但在美国这里，这些沉重的身影即使肩并肩站着，也让人感到完全的孤立。所以我画了它们，但剥离了它们原本的铁锈。我强行把各种奇怪的纹理赋予它们的身体。有一个正在字面意义上地融化。另一个被困在死板的棋盘格图案里。我想测试当你完全把脸拿走时，身份是如何运作的。我们仅仅是变成了我们穿在身上的图形图案吗？我们行走。我们占据空间。我们只是从来没有真正看着彼此。

items.title: Staged Memory / 被排演的记忆
items.meta: **Year:** 2024 **Medium:** Oil on canvas **Size:** 22 x 28 in
items.description:
Dust floats in sharp beams of yellow light. The stage is bright. But she stands completely in the shadows. I painted a traditional Chinese theater to map the exact distance between a person and their own history. Growing up in Beijing, this culture surrounds you. Now in Chicago, I feel like a spectator of my own heritage. So I used thick oil paint to make the light beams feel like solid, physical barriers. The figure in the foreground wears heavy theatrical makeup. She is dressed for the part. And yet her gaze is totally detached. She is not looking at the performance. Is she an actor who stepped off the stage, or an audience member who got too close? We put our cultural memory under a spotlight. Do we actually live inside it, or do we just watch it perform for us in the dark?

灰尘在锐利的黄色光束中漂浮。舞台很亮。但她完全站在阴影里。我画了一个传统的中国戏院，是为了映射一个人与她自身历史之间的精确距离。在北京长大，这种文化包围着你。现在在芝加哥，我觉得自己像是我自身文化遗产的旁观者。所以我用厚重的油画颜料，让这些光束感觉像是坚固的物理屏障。前景中的人物化着浓重的戏曲妆容。她穿着符合角色的服装。但她的眼神却完全是游离的。她没有在看表演。她是一个走下舞台的演员，还是一个靠得太近的观众？我们将我们的文化记忆置于聚光灯下。我们真的生活在其中吗，还是仅仅在黑暗中看着它为我们表演？

items.title: Medical Astrology: The Hidden Flame / 《内纹星图：暗焰》
items.meta: Year: 2025  Title: : Ink on tracing paper, digital prints, lightbox  Size: 8.5 x 11 in (each)
items.description:
This series reimagines the body as a sacred vessel. Based on Hermetic "correspondence," I map Zodiac signs onto organs---visualizing the Aries ram in the brain. The work is a lightbox installation constructed from four stacked layers: (1) Exterior tattoos on tracing paper; (2) Skin photograph on bond paper; (3) Internal Zodiac tattoos on tracing paper; (4) Internal organ photograph. The experience transforms with light. OFF: Viewers see only the mundane outer skin. ON: Backlighting penetrates the layers, suddenly revealing the hidden organs and glowing "inner tattoos" beneath. This mechanism visualizes Gnostic revelation: light exposing the divine spark hidden within the flesh, turning anatomy into theology.

这一系列作品将人体重新诠释为神圣的容器。基于赫尔墨斯主义的"对应"原则，我将十二星座符号映射到人体器官上——例如，将白羊座的公羊形象置于大脑中。这件作品是一个由四层叠加而成的灯箱装置：（1）描图纸上的外部纹身；（2）普通纸上的皮肤照片；（3）描图纸上的内部十二星座纹身；（4）内部器官照片。作品的观感会随着光线的变化而改变。灯光关闭时：观众只能看到普通的外部皮肤。灯光开启时：背光穿透各层，突然显露出隐藏在下方的器官和闪耀的"内部纹身"。这种机制形象地展现了诺斯替教的启示：光芒揭示了隐藏在肉体中的神圣火花，将解剖学转化为神学。

items.title: Stripping the Flesh / Pure Energy / 剥离血肉 / 纯粹能量
items.meta: Year: 2026  Medium: Ink on paper / 纸本水墨  Size: 27 x 27 in
items.description:
I washed away the meat. I only want the pure, vibrating energy underneath the biological body. The skin is a defensive lie. So I used fluid ink to paint a coiled snake skeleton. Just the spine. This strips the physical form down to its absolute core. I map the raw rhythm of life before it gets trapped inside a fleshy shell.

我洗刷掉了皮肉。我只想要生物躯体之下那纯粹的、振动的能量。皮肤是一个防御性的谎言。所以我用流动的水墨画了一具盘绕的蛇骨架。只有脊柱。这把物理形态剥离到了它绝对的核心。我在生命被困入肉体躯壳之前，绘制了它最原始的节律。

items.title: Spirit Feather  / 灵羽
items.meta: 2026,Medium: Ceramic sculpture / 陶瓷雕塑,Size: 16 x 9 x 9 in
items.description:
*Spirit Feather* depicts a goddess who represents my own life force. Her form is based on the human body, but combines elements of feathers and flames. Feather-like shapes extend outward from her ears, while flame-like forms rise from her head. Together with the lines of her neck, shoulders, and chest, they create a sense of upward movement. These features become part of her body, making her a being between the human and the supernatural. Through ceramics, I bring together the lightness of feathers and the power of fire within a still body. In the title, "Spirit" represents inner energy and life force, while "Feather" symbolizes the desire to rise, grow, and move freely. This work continues my exploration of the relationship between the human body and the supernatural. It also allows me to transform my inner feelings into a visible form.

《灵羽》塑造了一位代表我自身生命力的神女。她以人形为基础，融合了飞羽与火焰的特征：耳侧的羽形向外舒展，头部的火焰状结构向上延伸，与胸肩、颈部的线条共同形成升腾的动势。这些形态融入她的身体，使她成为介于人与超自然生命之间的存在。我通过陶瓷，将羽的轻盈与火的力量凝聚在一个静止的身体中。"灵"指向内在的精神与生命力，"羽"则承载着向上生长、自由舒展的愿望。这件作品延续了我对人体与超自然关系的探索，也让我将内在的感受转化为一个可以被看见的形象。

items.image: images/The Book of Nightmares,8x6x0.6 in,Ink on paper, thread, pop-up book,2024.jpg
items.title: The Book of Nightmares / 噩梦之书(Click to view full pages)
items.meta: Year: 2024  Medium: Ink on paper, thread, pop-up book / 纸本水墨，线，立体书  Size: 21 x 15 x 1.5 cm (Closed)
items.description:
I imagine the passage from birth through death and into reincarnation as a dream spanning an entire existence. Through encounters and entanglements with the world, a person develops a sense of self while experiencing fear, struggle, and loss. Death brings one lifetime to an end, while the soul moves toward the unknown of another life. The fear of ceasing to exist and the longing to remain are woven through this cycle, linking each ending to a beginning.

我将人从出生到死亡，再到灵魂转世的历程，化为一场贯穿生命的梦。人在与世界的纠缠中逐渐认识自身，也经历恐惧、挣扎与失去。死亡结束了一次人生，灵魂又走向未知的新生。对消逝的恐惧与对存在的眷恋，交织在这一轮回之中，连接着生命的终点与起点。

items.meta: Year: 2022 Medium glass, clay, acrylic, yarn,glitter Size 20*15*15in
items.title: Light up / 《点亮》
items.description:
Glass is transparent, yet blurred by the reflections which represent my inner world and the ethereal distance between people. I used navy clothes to represent the universe, and the floating glass cubes to represent the wandering lonely souls awaiting warmth.

作品的主体是由玻璃围合成的正方体组成，玻璃有着看得透摸不透的特点。以此来表示人的内心世界，突出了人与人之间有着无形距离的特点。我用黑蓝布作为宇宙，那些盒子漂浮在宇宙就是孤寂的灵魂在宇宙中飘荡，等待温暖的灵魂相遇。三年前我刚来加拿大，当时感觉自己很孤独，无助挣扎纠结的内心。直到我有了朋友逐渐靠近，给了我温暖。每个人都会有难过低落的时候，旁人的安慰与帮助可以点亮失落的内心。我希望能通过这个作品激发更多人际关系中的善意，当我们看到别人遇到困难的时候能多去温暖他人。

items.meta: Year: 2024 Medium: Digital photograph / Self-Portrait Size: 16:9
items.title: Self-Portrait: The Chrysalis of Shadow / 《自画像：影之蛹》
items.description:
In this intimate self-portrait, I explore the boundary between containment and liberation. Submerged in dark, tranquil waters, I am depicted as an ethereal being—part human, part myth—finding solace in the shadows. The grand, textured wings contrast against the soft ripples of the water, symbolizing a quiet transformation or a state of dreaming. Bathed in a focal light emanating from my own hands, this piece is an introspection on inner illumination, embracing one's own mysteries, and the delicate beauty found within the dark.

在这幅亲密的自画像里，我探索禁锢与解放之间的边界。沉入黑暗静谧的水中，我被塑造成一个空灵的存在——半人、半神话，在阴影中找到慰藉。宏大而富有肌理的翅膀与水面柔和的涟漪形成对比，象征一场安静的蜕变，或一种梦境般的状态。沐浴在从我自己双手发出的聚焦之光中，这件作品是对内在之光的内省，对自身神秘的接纳，以及对黑暗中那份精致之美的凝视。

items.title: Chromium Covenant: Iron and White / 《铬之契约：铁与白》
items.description:
1. Theme: Anachronism and Industrial Order
   In this piece, I continue to visually investigate the concept of anachronism. I placed the subject, draped in translucent white classical fabric and adorned with botanical elements, within a dark, distinctly industrial environment. This is a visual collision between the fragile and the permanent. The figure is not a victim within this sterile space; through her posture and direct gaze, she anchors herself against this rigid, abandoned structure, forging a new myth within the industrial ruins.

   Artistic Technique: Material Tension and Directional Light
   I approach this image as a study of diametric opposites—absolute hardness versus absolute softness.

   Collision of Matter: The core physical focus is the extreme contrast between the matte, rough texture of the black cast-iron bar and the lightweight, light-transmitting white fabric. The iron represents insurmountable physical resistance, while the fabric and flora represent organic fluidity.

   Light as a Chisel: I utilized a single, high-intensity directional light (spotlight) to "sculpt" the frame. This light cuts through the darkness like a scalpel, forcibly extracting the figure from a background devoid of absolute depth. The high-contrast chiaroscuro erases extraneous environmental data, forcing the eye to focus on the material textures within the illuminated zones.

   Compositional Rigidity vs. Organic Form: The cast-iron bar establishes an absolutely horizontal, rigid dividing line across the center of the frame. The placement of the subject's arm and the tilt of her torso disrupt this sterile horizontal, injecting human physical tension into what is otherwise a static mechanical structure.

   主题：时代错置与工业秩序
   在这件作品里，我继续从视觉上追问"时代错置"这一概念。我把人物置于一个黑暗的、典型的工业环境中，她披着半透明的白色古典织物，点缀着植物元素。这是脆弱与永恒之间的视觉碰撞。在这个冷峻的空间里，人物并非受害者——她以姿态和直视将自己锚定在这座僵硬的、被遗弃的结构之上，在工业废墟中锻造新的神话。

   创作手法：材质张力与定向光
   我把这幅影像当作一组极端对立的研究——绝对的硬，对绝对的软。

   物质的碰撞：核心的物质焦点，是黑色铸铁栏杆哑光粗糙的质感与轻盈透光的白色织物之间的极端对比。铁代表不可逾越的物理阻力，织物与植物代表有机的流动性。

   光即凿子：我用一束高强度的定向光（聚光灯）来"雕刻"画面。这束光如手术刀般划开黑暗，把人物从一片没有纵深的背景中硬生生剜出。高对比的明暗抹去了多余的环境信息，迫使视线聚焦在受光区域的材质肌理上。

   构图的刚性与有机的形：铸铁栏杆在画面中央划出一条绝对水平的、僵硬的分界线。人物手臂的摆放与躯干的倾斜打破了这条冷峻的水平线，把人的身体张力注入这个原本静态的机械结构。
items.meta: Year: 2024 Medium: Digital photograph
Year: 2023 Medium: Digital photograph
items.title: Night Drift / 夜之漂流（摄影）
items.description:
1. \### 1. Theme: Urban Interiority and the "Blue Hour"

   Does the city illuminate us, or does it drown us? This piece, \_Night Drift\_, explores the psychological state of \*\*interiority\*\* amidst urban chaos. The subject turns her gaze downward, rejecting the viewer's eye. She refuses to participate in the spectacle surrounding her. It captures a specific form of modern solitude often felt by the diaspora—standing physically within the dazzling lights of a metropolis, yet remaining emotionally untethered. The golden, frantic energy of the water suggests the relentless pace of the external world. But the figure? She is a pool of silence. The image is not a portrait of a person; it is a portrait of a barrier. It visualizes the quiet wall we build to protect our thoughts from the noise.

   ### 2. Technique: Digital Pictorialism & Structural Weight

   I approached the sensor not as a recording device, but as a canvas for \*\*subtractive mixing\*\*.

   - \*\*The Dissolution of Form:\*\* By utilizing an extremely shallow depth of field, I forced the background context to disintegrate. The river lights are not rendered as objects but as pure \*\*bokeh\*\* textures—abstract strokes of cyan and gold that mimic the broken brushwork of late Impressionism. Reality dissolves into atmosphere.

   - \*\*Compositional Anchoring:\*\* To prevent the image from becoming ethereal to the point of weakness, the composition relies on heavy \*\*visual mass\*\* at the bottom. The rich, dark texture of the scarf and the negative space of the black attire create a solid pyramidal base. This heavy, tactile foreground forces a stark collision with the ephemeral, shimmering background.

   - \*\*Chromatic Tension:\*\* The color grading deliberately pushes the \*\*complementary contrast\*\* between the melancholic, cool blues of the twilight shadows and the burning, electric warmth of the artificial lights. This is not just aesthetic; the color temperature conflict visualizes the tension between the cold, objective reality and the warm, subjective inner world.

   ### 1. 作品主题：都市内在性与"蓝色时刻"

   城市是在照亮我们，还是在淹没我们？这件作品《夜之漂流 (Night Drift)》探讨了都市混乱中的一种"内在性 (interiority)"心理状态。主体视线低垂，拒绝了观看者的目光。她拒绝参与包围着她的奇观。这捕捉到了离散人群常感到的一种特定的现代孤独——肉身处于大都市耀眼的灯光中，情感却毫无羁绊。水面上金色的、疯狂的能量暗示了外部世界无情的节奏。但人物呢？她是一潭寂静。这幅图像不是对一个人的肖像描绘；它是对一道屏障的描绘。它具象化了我们为保护思想免受喧嚣侵扰而建立的那堵无声的墙。

   ### 2. 表达手法：数字画意摄影与结构分量

   我将传感器不视为记录设备，而是视为减法混合的画布。

   - 形式的消解：通过使用极浅的景深，我强迫背景语境崩解。河上的灯光不再被渲染为物体，而是纯粹的焦外成像 (bokeh)肌理——青色和金色的抽象笔触，模仿了晚期印象派的破碎笔法。现实溶解为氛围。

   - 构图锚定：为了防止图像因过于空灵而显得软弱，构图依赖于底部沉重的视觉质量 (visual mass)。围巾丰富、深沉的质感与黑色服饰的负空间创造了一个坚固的金字塔基座。这种沉重的、可触知的前景强迫其与短暂、闪烁的背景发生剧烈的碰撞。

   - 色彩张力：调色刻意推高了互补色对比，即暮色阴影中忧郁的冷蓝色与人造灯光燃烧般的、带电的温暖色之间的对比。这不仅仅是美学考量；色温的冲突视觉化了冰冷、客观的现实与温暖、主观的内心世界之间的张力。

items.title: Chromium Covenant / 铬之契约（摄影）
items.description:
\### 1. Theme: Anachronism and the New Mythology

History is usually written in stone. It's heavy, rigid, and often excludes faces that look like mine. This piece, \_Chromium Covenant\_, explores the concept of \*\*anachronism\*\*—placing something outside of its proper time. I wanted to stage a visual collision. We have the weight of Western neoclassical architecture and the traditional symbolism of the sword—both ancient structures of power. Yet, the figure is clad in futuristic, liquid metal. She is a time traveler. She is subverting the classical narrative. She isn't asking for permission to enter this historical space; by gripping the blade, she is seizing agency within it. The theme is not about blending in; it is about the jarring, beautiful contrast of a contemporary identity forging a new mythology amidst the ruins of an old world.

### 2. Technique: Material Contrast & Sculptural Light

I approached this image as a study in extreme \*\*textural opposition\*\*. I treated the sensor like a canvas for varying surfaces.

- \*\*The Collision of Matters:\*\* The primary technical focus is the aggressive contrast between the matte, weathered texture of the stone columns and the highly reflective, synthetic surface of the silver dress. The stone absorbs light; the dress repels it. This creates a tactile tension across the frame.

- \*\*Light as a Chisel:\*\* I utilized the bright, diffused daylight to "sculpt" the figure. The light hits the metallic folds of the dress, turning the fabric into what looks like molten lead or mercury. It gives the soft fabric a sense of rigid armor.

- \*\*Compositional Rigidity vs. Organic Form:\*\* The composition relies on the imposing vertical lines of the architectural columns to create a rigid grid. The organic curve of the figure's body and the diagonal tilt of her head break this grid, introducing necessary human tension into the cold stone environment.

### 1. 作品主题：时代错置与新神话

历史通常是用石头书写的。它沉重、僵化，并且经常排除像我这样的面孔。这件作品《铬之契约 (Chromium Covenant)》探讨了"时代错置 (anachronism)"的概念——将某物置于其恰当的时间之外。我想要上演一场视觉碰撞。我们有西方新古典主义建筑的重量和剑的传统象征意义——这使得两者都成为了权力的古老结构。然而，人物却身着未来主义的液态金属。她是一个时间旅行者。她正在颠覆古典叙事。她不是在请求进入这个历史空间；通过紧握剑柄，她正在其中夺取主动权。主题不在于融合；而在于一种不和谐的、美丽的对比，即一个当代身份在旧世界的废墟中锻造一个新的神话。

### 2. 表达手法：材质对比与雕塑光

我将这幅图像视为一项极端质感对立的研究。我把传感器当作处理不同表面的画布。

- 物质的碰撞：主要的技术焦点是石柱的哑光、风化纹理与银色裙子的高反光、合成表面之间的强烈对比。石头吸收光线；裙子排斥光线。这在整个画面中创造了一种触觉张力。

- 光即凿子：我利用明亮、漫射的日光来"雕刻"人物。光线打在裙子的金属褶皱上，把织物变成了看起来像熔化的铅或水银一样的东西。它赋予了柔软的织物一种刚性盔甲的感觉。

- 构图刚性与有机形态：构图依赖建筑圆柱体庄严的垂直线条来创造一个刚性的网格。人物身体的有机曲线和她头部的倾斜打破了这个网格，将必要的人类张力引入到冰冷的石质环境中。
items.meta: Medium: Digital photograph

items.title: Chromium Covenant: The Liquid Threshold / 《铬之契约：液阈》
items.meta: Year: 2023 Medium: Digital photograph
items.description:
Theme: Anachronism and the Artificial Threshold
In this piece, the "anachronism" manifests as a natural phenomenon physically isolated by an artificial landscape—the aquarium viewing window. I positioned the figure before a massive, pressurized glass interface, a threshold space connecting dried reality with a synthetic deep-sea environment. The visual conflict erupts between the cold precision of modern engineering and the primordial, fluid energy beneath the surface. Reclined in a near-meditative state, the figure does not merely observe; she utilizes this transparent physical barrier to perform a sensory reclamation of "encapsulated nature."

Artistic Technique: Acrylic Refraction and Spectral Spill
I treat this shoot as a study of the physical properties of light as it penetrates a heavy, artificial medium (acrylic).

Collision of Matter: The frame is divided by the thick glass of the viewing window into two distinct density fields. The foreground consists of dry, concrete air and fabric; the background is a high-pressure, granular blue fluid. This physical spatiality, forcibly separated by industrial materials, creates a visual sense of deep-sea compression.

Light Penetration and Refraction: I relied entirely on the artificial cool-blue light sources from within the tank. As light penetrates the thick transparent medium, it undergoes refraction and spills into the darkened viewing area in diffused, low-frequency wavelengths. This refracted light catches the edges of the gown's folds, granting the white fabric a visual illusion of bioluminescence.

Geometric Confinement and Somatic Deconstruction: The circular viewport establishes the rigid boundary of the composition, symbolizing the human containment and observation of oceanic power. The diagonal organic curve of the subject's body disrupts the perfect circularity, introducing an organic and unpredictable variable into this engineered framework.

主题：时代错置与人造阈限
在这件作品里，"时代错置"呈现为一种被人工景观物理隔绝的自然现象——水族馆的观景窗。我把人物置于一面巨大的、承压的玻璃界面之前，那是一个连接干燥现实与合成深海环境的阈限空间。视觉冲突在现代工程的冷峻精确与水面之下原始的、流动的能量之间爆发。人物以近乎冥想的姿态斜倚，不只是观看——她借这道透明的物理屏障，完成了一次对"被封装的自然"的感官收复。

创作手法：亚克力的折射与光谱漫溢
我把这次拍摄当作对光穿透厚重人造介质（亚克力）时物理特性的一项研究。

物质的碰撞：观景窗的厚玻璃把画面分成两个密度截然不同的场域。前景是干燥的、具体的空气和织物；背景是高压的、颗粒感的蓝色流体。这种被工业材料强行分隔的物理空间感，营造出一种深海压缩的视觉感受。

光的穿透与折射：我完全依赖水箱内部的人造冷蓝色光源。光穿透厚重的透明介质时发生折射，以漫射的、低频的波长漫入黑暗的观景区域。折射的光落在裙摆褶皱的边缘，令白色织物产生一种生物荧光般的视觉错觉。

几何的禁锢与身体的解构：圆形的观景窗确立了构图僵硬的边界，象征人类对海洋力量的收容与观看。人物身体斜向的有机曲线打破了完美的圆形，给这个精密构筑的框架引入了一个有机的、不可预测的变量。
